data.name: Daanayah
data.gender_notes: Daanayah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: She who is relaxed, easy, and at peace. The name Daanayah carries the meaning “Relaxed, Easy” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Daanayah usually hope their child will grow to embody relaxed, easy and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for a gentle and calm soul
data.etymology: Daanayah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Relaxed, Easy.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Daanayah total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: داانياه
in_arabic.long_meaning: داانياه هو الاسم العربي المشتق من الجذر (د ن ي) والذي يعني البرق، النور، المجد، التاج، والإشراق. يعتبر الاسم شائعًا بين مسلمي العالم، وتوجد له معاني متعددة في مختلف الثقافات الإسلامية.

in_urdu.name: داانیہ

in_hindi.name: दानियाह

It is a reminder of the importance of living a balanced and peaceful life amidst the hustle and bustle of everyday life. This name could serve as an inspiration for individuals who are constantly seeking reassurance and calmness within their dynamic worlds.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Daanayah holds deep significance as it represents a state of inner peace and contentment. It serves as a reminder for individuals to seek solace in their faith during troubling times and to strive towards living a life that is centered around spiritual growth and connection with the divine. The spiritual qualities embodied by the name Daanayah, such as serenity and calmness, are essential for maintaining a strong and unwavering relationship with Allah (SWT).
